description: Plan personalized trips with ChatGPT and save them in Trips, Made Yours. Organize routes, transport, accommodation options, activities, budgets, and checklists in one shared travel plan. Reopen saved trips later and update them through ChatGPT. Trips, Made Yours. is a planning aid and does not make bookings or process payments.

defaultPrompt: Plan a two-week trip to Hawaii in January for two people and save it directly.
Show me my saved trips and open the next one.
Update my next trip based on my preferences.
